body:
On the ARM VM (88e215ed, NEON, release, `r88-audit-arm-20261108T164358-70eac117`, VERIFIED), with no group path: a repeated index x2 gives 1 right and 1 empty-message digest, **x16 gives 1 right and 15 empty**, x17 1 and 16. The debug build stops at the existing `debug_assert` ("each finalized index is distinct"). So off AVX-512 every repeat past the first is silently wrong.

— Sam Shackleton
